physical_conditions.note: Window replay of a 20-packet contiguous segment captured at session start (reboot-range starting sequence). The first replayed packet trips the reboot heuristic; the remainder are accepted as a fresh stream.

integrity.note: Carrier packets carry their original valid HMAC. A2.3 forged packets carry a freshly computed valid HMAC over the replayed payload (models the IP-F compromised node). Every row verifies under host_receiver logic.

known_limitations: Carrier sensor values are the firmware rand() stub (payload_is_physical false). This episode demonstrates the transport-layer freshness response to replay, which is independent of payload content and therefore valid on the stub.

receiver_detection_result is the receiver verdict, carried as a feature. The ground-truth label is attack_code, set by construction. Do not train on the verdict (labels_schema prohibited_label_sources).
